answers.name: Fit Guide
answers.description: Lets clothing merchants show size charts on product pages so shoppers pick the right size and return less.
answers.functionalities: Create size charts as tables of sizes and measurements; Assign a chart to products, collections or product tags; Show a 'Size chart' link on the product page that opens the chart in a popup; Switch measurements between cm and inches
answers.flow: The merchant installs the app, creates a size chart, assigns it to products or a collection, and adds the size chart block to the product page. Shoppers click 'Size chart' to see the measurements.

mentions.label: metaobjects or metafields for the charts

criteria: The architecture says the app is free and adds no billing.
It defines which chart wins when a product matches more than one assignment (product, collection, tag).
The storefront popup is keyboard accessible and can be closed with Escape.
The cm/inch switch works on the storefront without a page reload.
Every admin screen has loading, empty and error states.
